# Key figures for the manuscript text (review round 2)

<!-- generated by scripts/t16_cifras_clave.py; do not edit by hand -->

Every figure below is copied from a CSV in `13_revision_r2/resultados/` (named after each line, with the LaTeX table in `latex/` that shows it). MAE in tonnes (t); sour lime without decimals, sweet lime with one; 95% CI: paired bootstrap of months within each test window (B = 10,000, seed 42); DM: Diebold–Mariano with HLN correction, absolute loss. Unless stated otherwise: pool of test windows 2021–2025 (60 months per crop). All analyses in this list are post-protocol (second review round) and do not modify the pre-registered ten-model ranking. * = first or tied with the first.
